notes.title: Effie developers announce new dark survival game Peregrino
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33890535/7e86970a6d3b1510f00bcb71036ffc6d3229c907.jpg"][/img][/p][p]We are happy to announce our new game, [b][i]Peregrino[/i][/b], a harrowing isometric survival game set in a cursed land steeped in gothic horror and religious folklore. In Peregrino, players must lead a group of desperate pilgrims through the perilous "land in-between"—a dark purgatory guarded by divine custodians. The goal is to reach New Eden, a promised paradise. But the journey is brutal, and survival is far from guaranteed.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33890535/c77e9f10196cc367346863cee896c433b25f5225.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]In Peregrino, survival hinges on your ability to lead, adapt, and endure. As you traverse the unforgiving land in-between, you’ll need to scavenge, hunt, and fight to keep your caravan alive. Resource management is critical—food, shelter, and faith must be balanced against a backdrop of ever-present danger. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33890535/18a791eb94b9528610a09dd6355ddcc5ab13d9b9.jpg"][/img]
[/p][p]Each night brings greater threats, as the grotesque abominations grow stronger, forcing you to test your faith and your tactics. But brute force isn’t enough. Every pilgrim you lead carries a personal story, unique skills, and a fragile will to continue. Death is permanent, and your decisions—what to say, what to sacrifice—can sway their loyalty or doom their fate.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33890535/160558cac5f8415f2c16290ea6c63f200a47345c.jpg"][/img]
[/p][p]A full list of key features include:[/p][list][*][p][b]Brutal Survival Management:[/b] Scavenge, hunt, and battle to keep your caravan alive in a hostile world. Balance resources, food, shelter, and faith as dangers close in.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Gruesome Horror Journey:[/b] Face off against nightmarish abominations that emerge stronger at dusk, testing your faith and resolve.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Character-Driven Storytelling:[/b] Each pilgrim has a name, backstory, and purpose. Your decisions shape their fate, and once they're gone—they’re gone for good.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Customize Your Bastion:[/b] Upgrade wagons, fortify walls, and enhance mobility to protect your caravan from the horrors that lurk in the shadows.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Strategic Risk and Reward:[/b] Choose your route through the cursed forest, manage limited inventory space, and decide what’s worth saving—and what must be left behind.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Gothic Visual Identity:[/b] Experience a grim 19th-century setting brought to life with a handcrafted isometric aesthetic inspired by classic religious art and folklore.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Wishlist now [b][i]Peregrino[/i][/b] and join us on this journey!

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3268150/Peregrino/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Creatures of Ava | Announcement Trailer
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Creatures of Ava is a unique take on an action-adventure, creature saver game. Watch the Announcement Trailer and get ready to understand and tame the creatures of Ava. Let them lead you through a variety of ecosystems – all in the hopes of saving the planet from a life-consuming infection.

[previewyoutube=0sc1X5t_8vI;full][/previewyoutube]
In Creatures of Ava, players assume the role of Vic, a young nature explorer, on her expedition to planet Ava. The mission: save the planet's inhabitants from an infection called "the withering". Explore the distinct and colorful biospheres of Ava, tame wild creatures with the music of a special flute, meet the naam (Ava's inhabitants) and learn their unique customs, and help Vic solve the secrets of Ava and her own troubled past!

notes.title: What does the press say about Effie?
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33890535/20ee6e005916ad937751787a9655c46fae16213b.png[/img]

Hey folks,

[b]Only 3 days[/b] until the release of Effie on Steam and we want to collect and resume here the honest statements drawn from press worldwide:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33890535/a2ba540e5dfcaa5fdae37782351786bc1fc484c0.png[/img]
[i]Here's yet another criminally underrated indie gem. Effie is an immersive and striking 3D platformer that has you beat on enemies and work through tricky scenarios with the help of some very cool abilities. I absolutely fell in love with its world via its delightful graphics and voice acting and I'm sure you will, too. It easily deserves to be 3D Platformer of the Year.[/i]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33890535/db843c511ef59c99f9a1aec2d4d80af5a627077b.png[/img]

[i]Effie is good 3D Platformer that left me with a big smile on face. The Red Plains are a beautiful location to explore, especially given that you have an awesome hoverboard to do it with. The combat does hold it back a bit but the overall package is one that fans of 3D Platformers should definitely experience.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33890535/9e499be62a2fd03359735deb66b2a7d45b8f3fe3.png[/img]
[i]Effie is a fun 3D puzzle-platformer which pays homage to the classics of yesteryear perfectly. The vivid and luminous contrast between the choices of colours the developers have opted to use, really makes the games visuals pop out of your screen as every single scene is like a child’s colouring book where they’ve gone crazy with the bright primary colours![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33890535/d95df652061eedc969cf8cd1a5bdd1ec3c4a5565.png[/img]
[i]Platforms, adventure and a lot of feeling combined in a work that oozes talent and shows a promising studio. A must for lovers of classic adventures.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33890535/5ddc7ca9c5a26d0fc2235215d6c64a32b9b10844.png[/img]
[i]Effie is one of those games I just picked up and enjoyed playing from start to finish in one day. The developer has done extremely well to merge old-school 3D platforming with an open world design, some RPG-lite mechanics, ARPG-like combat and some great puzzles that never felt frustrating. Throw in a fantasy story that kept me wanting more as well as beautiful graphics and the ability to surf around on a shield, and you have a winner on your hands.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33890535/188556d51ce589d149fa64d135b431a0edbcf472.png[/img]
[i]Effie excels when the player is tired of complex systems and strategies being shoved in their face. When you want to rediscover a youthful love for adventure and magic, Effie is the perfect game. It’s for these reasons that I’ve rated Effie: 8.5/10.[/i]


On January 28 Effie will be available on Steam and we hope to read your user review! ːsteamhappyː


https://store.steampowered.com/app/975950/Effie/

notes.title: Runestone, your travel companion
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33890535/3f1e8231631c5f3fa234ed4695d32502b5aecf26.jpg[/img]

Big stories are always told by great characters. In this story, our hero Galand is accompanied by a singular magic shield, called Runestone. It was a unique gift from The Elder Protectors, which were introduced last week in [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/975950/announcements/detail/1700605756077323485]this post.[/url]

Runestone is a powerful magic shield, which can learn new abilities throughout the game. Those new abilities will be powerful options that will improve your combat skills. In some cases, you would need those abilities to overcome the levels.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33890535/61feedb868a8cc86d4d6148ed5cb968fc1bfcb7c.jpg[/img]

There're also some special actions that Runestone is able to do, like… carrying Galand’s weight and making him surf through the beautiful red landscapes of Oblena! Sounds cool, right? It is!

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/1iUKOTJ4WghzKNqNtX/giphy-downsized-large.gif[/img]

In order to make the power of Runestone stronger, you’ll need to feed it. For that, it will be useful to collect the rune stones spread out the Oblena region. It’s very easy to find them, as they shine so brightly. Moreover, there are a lot of them!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33890535/3e4fafa094891a3dbb1234950af1c4b7f681b084.jpg[/img]

Only two weeks remaining for the release! Soon you’ll be able to live the adventure with Runestone. Meanwhile, you can [b]add Effie to your wishlist![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/975950/Effie/

notes.title: The Story of the Elder Protectors
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33890535/18ef3b901b0220444ed44b629c95a73bd6f4ab7a.png[/img]

According to a legend, a long time ago, there was a temple where all of the world's decisions were taken. It was in a far away land, very close to the Forgotten Lands, like Oblena. Those who used to take that important decisions were called The Elder Protectors. For sure, they were gods in this world, as they had an incomparable magic power.

The Elder Protectors looked after the world during thousands of years. Everyone revered them and a temple was built for their veneration in every region of the world. But, little by little, they lost their devotees and with them, their power diminished, until they were practically forgotten.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33890535/9e2c047e6805bf04a84c67352e5bf4ccca199867.png[/img]

In Effie, you’ll visit two temples: The Temple of the Elder Protectors and the Temple of Oblena. The first one is the original, where those pure magic beings used to be. And it's the starting point of this fantasy tale. The second one is the temple built in the red region of Oblena. The gaze of those who see everything is also present there.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33890535/e8d75a61478c9ddcfdc973ca4e92187f613b76aa.png[/img]

The Elder Protectores will accompany you during your adventure.
They will show you the way.
Your way.

If you don’t have Effie in your wishlist, you’re late! Add it to your wishlist now! ːsteamhappyː

https://store.steampowered.com/app/975950/Effie/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33890535/cd82f0c8a25ac334332d214cfbb8a2903ca13b05.png[/img]

notes.title: Meet The Vineyards: an ode to the grape
notes.notes:
The Vineyards is one of the settlements in Oblena. It’s clearly recognized by its two enormous barrels, which can be seen from miles away. The city is close to those barrels, but mystic things happen inside them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33890535/a94c032763f99ccd7a912d21cd0f92ffff184bfc.png[/img]

Despite the fact the evil has invaded the region, the barrels are still a grape juice factory, since the imps have continued working there. The only difference is that those imps have changed the grape juice recipe, more adapted to their tastes.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/GC4TFvK.gif[/img]

Here’s a pic of the city, where there’s nothing very special. However, it’s a beautiful place and, internally in the studio, we call it The Little Venice, because it looks quite similar.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33890535/850da99a552a3a4504bf69f1d972a16691bdbc91.png[/img]

I won’t go much further, because I want you to explore the whole factory and there’re a lot of places in the settlement. However, to conclude, I want to show you pictures of two cool places that you can find inside the factory.

The first one is the museum. The museum? Yes, the best factories have one!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33890535/e40b4da15bc4cfd434917144034034e76770f0eb.png[/img]

The second one is the Uonka level. It's super cool as it will remind you to some sweet places!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33890535/0cdef0f2a589232d70459f432ad14de05810ea92.png[/img]

Finally, just a reminder: you can add Effie to your wishlist now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/975950/Effie/

notes.title: Effie lands on Steam on January 28
notes.notes:
Hi folks!

We’ve great news: Effie is coming to Steam on January 28!

If you’re new here, Effie is a 3D action-platformer game that combines classic elements from the genre, such as combat, platforming, and puzzles, with the exploration of an expanded world. It will remind you a lot to other classic PlayStation games like Jak & Daxter, Maximo or Ratchet and Clank, as they’ve been an inspiration for its development!
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33890535/d5a62072fb73af335a94bfaa55cffc557fb34cd4.png[/img]

If you already knew us, thank you so much for your patient. We’ve been working very hard during the last months to bring Effie to PC, and we’re already testing a fairly final version. Although at the beginning our intention was to launch Effie in autumn, we’ve prioritized releasing a more polished game, and we want to say sorry for this delay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33890535/cd5e2a0c43d279b146073f94486b62593845c67b.png[/img]

We want to keep you informed of all news related to Effie so we’d appreciate a lot if you could add Effie to your wishlist! Moreover, it will help us to gain some visibility.

notes.title: Get ready to surf over your shield!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/nWIfduP.gif[/img]

Hi folks!

Today we wanted to show you the surf mechanics. The red region of Oblena is huge. There are some cities/settlements and many places to discover, so Galand needed a vehicle to make it fun to move around!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33890535/2eb139e51dc34671b7ea2afffdfabfb1374d5028.jpg[/img]

And we thought: okay, fighting with a shield like Captain America is cool, but what if he also surfs over it? That would be awesome!! So that’s what we did: a multipurpose shield.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/MD8Hzry.gif[/img]

Apart from surfing over the shield throughout the Oblena region, you can find multiple turbos scattered around it, as well as huge jumps... when you want to notice, you'll think: am I flying?

[img]https://i.imgur.com/P7myVtI.gif[/img]

Discover the surf mechanics by yourself, [b]adding Effie to your wishlist now![/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33890535/5c7973de608cbeffbfa5a34c3e3d49f4f95459a8.png[/img]

notes.title: Meet Windmills City
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33890535/f9ca33ce06ccd342caea837d6aecdee6e0d172d0.jpg[/img]

The story of Effie takes place in the Red Plains of Oblena, a vast red meadow, characterized of course by its red vegetation. This region has several cities and settlements, and one of them is Windmills City, of which we are going to make a small introduction today.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33890535/341cb3f0bae694686d4be3847107010d9c48a55c.jpg[/img]

Windmills City is the closest town to the Temple of the Elder Protectors, an sacred ancient place in Oblena. It is surrounded by wheat fields and stands out with its large central mill. It also has five other tower-mills, and joined together, these create a huge fortress-city.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33890535/72594e9e0ae725578335639d102426daf2c1de3d.jpg[/img]

Within the city we can find places such as the market, the housing area or the great hall. There is also a small stream that crosses the city.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33890535/f429f4de9f9a1b5d7f9cba1c4ca570cec8011a0a.jpg[/img]

But its extension isn't limited to what it contains. In the game, you can climb the fortress or even enter to it. One by one, you can go through all its towers.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33890535/ba507533403bb0d394fcfb9ac3995e5ef73fdafa.jpg[/img]

And below the city... below you will find more…

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33890535/dff0302eced61b022211d06c5f1dce5b063c65d4.jpg[/img]

ːsteamhappyː Don’t forget to [b]add Effie to your wishlist[/b] and discover Windmills City by yourself! ːsteamhappyː

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33890535/5c7973de608cbeffbfa5a34c3e3d49f4f95459a8.png[/img]

notes.title: A 3D action and platforming adventure arrives in 2019
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33890535/86524f6c83b505ab0c11ffc8977f709436116497.jpg[/img]

Hi everyone!

It's a pleasure for Inverge Studios to present Effie, a 3D platforming adventure that will reach the platform in 2019.

[h1]What is Effie?[/h1]
Effie is an action-adventure game that combines classic elements from the genre, such as combat, platforming, and puzzles, with the exploration of an expanded world.

[h1]Action, adventure, platform, combat, puzzles...[/h1]
Yes! This probably brings you some nostalgia... because it sounds like old school! Memories of those classic console games that we enjoyed so much and spent so many hours in.

Effie is a new story, with modern graphics and a gameplay that feels comfortable. In it we will control Galand, a man who has been cursed with premature old age, and who will have to make up for lost time.

And he will try indeed... fighting with his shield!

[img]https://i.ibb.co/WK3MBwn/Combate-Defensa-Small256.gif[/img]

[h1]Do you want to know more?[/h1]
If you want to keep up to date and not miss anything of this new adventure, do not hesitate! Add the game to your wishlist, subscribe to the game newsletter, keep an eye on the news and get ready for lots of action and fun!

[b]Effie will be out this 2019![/b] ːsteamhappyː
